NCAA West All-regional team. }} '''Anthony Jordan Price''' (born {{birth date|1986|10|7}}),{{cite web|url=http://www.nbadraftdepot.com/2009/01/draft-profile-uconn-pg-aj-price.html |title=Draft Depot: Draft Profile: UConn PG AJ Price - An NBA Draft Site |publisher=Nbadraftdepot.com |date=1986-10-07 |accessdate=2009-06-14}} known as '''A.J. Price''', is an [[United States|American]] [[college basketball]] player. He is a 6'2" [[point guard]] for the [[University of Connecticut]]. He is projected to be taken in the late first round/second round of the 2009 NBA Draft.{{Fact|date=April 2009}} ==High School== A.J. grew up in Amityville, New York where he was a basketball star at his high school. He averaged 25.4 points, 3.0 steals, 5.0 assists and 7.0 rebounds in his junior year. He also won multiple state titles while being there. He accepted a scholarship to the University of Connecticut.{{cite web|url=http://basketballrecruiting.rivals.com/viewprospect.asp?pr_key=5154&Sport=2 |title=A. J. Price Profile - Basketball Recruiting |publisher=Basketballrecruiting.rivals.com |date= |accessdate=2009-06-14}} ==College== A.J. chose UConn over Florida St, Kansas and St. Johns. He sat out his Freshman Year due to a brain hemorrage that almost claimed his life.{{cite web|last=Brady |first=Erik |url=http://www.usatoday.com/sports/college/mensbasketball/bigeast/2005-01-12-price-sidelined_x.htm |title=67k |publisher=Usatoday.com |date=2005-01-12 |accessdate=2009-06-14}} His coming out party was in 2008-2009 season. He was the Huskies leading scorer with 14.7 points a game and was critical in their run to the final four. In a game vs Gonzaga he hit a falling down 3 pointer to force the game into overtime.{{cite web|url=http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=283552250&campaign=rss&source=ESPNHeadlines |title=Connecticut Huskies vs. Gonzaga Bulldogs - Recap - December 20, 2008 - ESPN |publisher=Sports.espn.go.com |date=2008-12-20 |accessdate=2009-06-14}} In the [[2009 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament]] he was named the most outstanding player in the West Region, but the huskies{{Fact|date=April 2009}}fell in the semi finals to the Michigan State Spartans. ==Personal Life== A.J. Price has had more than one legal incidents. In May 2004 Price was arrested in his hometown of Massapequa, N.Y., on misdemeanor criminal trespass charges. Also in June 2005 Price with teammate Marcus Williams was charged with three counts of felony larceny and lying to police, a misdemeanor. (though only Price was brought up on the latter charge) Price was caught stealing four laptop computers from a UConn dormitory. He received Probation for the crimes. He would play his pick up basketball games at John Burns Park in Massapequa. {{cite web|url=http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/news/story?id=2224935 |title=UConn guard Price gets probation in laptop case - Men's College Basketball - ESPN |publisher=Sports.espn.go.com |date=2005-11-15 |accessdate=2009-06-14}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Price, A.J.}} [[Category:UConn Huskies men's basketball players]] [[Category:American basketball players]] [[Category:African American basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from New York]] [[Category:Living people]]
